sloka: पुरा कृतयुगे राम मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः ।तस्य पुत्रो महानासीदिक्ष्वाकुः कुलनन्दनः ।। ७.७९.५ ॥
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rāma manurdaṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ ।tasya putro mahānāsīdikṣvākuḥ kulanandanaḥ ।। 7.79.5 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful lord named Manu, the wielder of the scepter, and his great son, Ikshvaku, was the delight of his family.
